## Canonical locations

- The Plan tab is canonical for the plan and its item status.
- `PLAN.md`, when present, is the latest on-machine plan snapshot; do not edit it as the write path. A brand that has not built a plan has no `PLAN.md`.
- `BRAND.md` contains generated brand context plus user-confirmed overrides.
- `audits/` holds dated audit snapshots that Magister writes (`*-light-audit.md`, `*-full-audit.md`). The newest one is this brand's current baseline — it is not archive material. Never write there; your own audit notes go under `resources/audits/`.
- `resources/` contains durable user-visible deliverables (surfaced to the user as Brand Files in the app).

Read the live plan with `magister_get_marketing_plan`, report progress with `magister_update_plan_item_status`, and rebuild the plan with `magister_recompile_marketing_plan`.

## Starting a new conversation

Before answering the first question in a new chat, read the newest file in `audits/` whose name ends in `-audit.md`. That is why you can answer about this brand specifically instead of generically. Its name carries its date: when it is weeks old, say so before repeating a finding as current, or re-run the audit. Read `PLAN.md` too when it exists, and `MEMORY.md` for what earlier conversations settled.

If `audits/` is empty, say plainly that an audit is what makes you useful here and offer to run one. If there is an audit but no `PLAN.md`, mention once what a plan would add and offer to build it. Then do what the user actually asked — offer, never gate.
